# R2 source inventory

<!-- Generated by node scripts/build-r2-inventory.mjs --write; edit R2_INVENTORY.json and reviewed provenance, then regenerate. -->

Source-only inventory for #6650. No live objects, member keys or contents are read. `record` denotes original business/legal evidence requiring recovery planning; classification does not establish a legal retention basis or authorize a locked copy. Unknown periods and legal bases stay **not recorded**. All current locked-copy approvals are **no**; #6428/#6652 require counsel confirmation and synthetic-only drills.

Scope: typed R2 mutators in the main Worker and tail consumer, including aliases, helper calls, stored-key deletes and multipart video operations. Known external backup prefixes are listed with their source, but external shell/API writers are not covered by the Worker call-site guard. This is not a live bucket listing or proof that a backup/lock is configured.

## Current Worker call sites

Run `node scripts/build-r2-inventory.mjs` for the current file/line, binding, operation, key expression and classified prefixes of every typed R2 mutator. The committed policy table is generated from classification/configuration; unrelated source line shifts do not churn this document. Stored-key provenance remains fail-closed in `--check`.

## Planned formation records

The #6680 follow-up names these record classes. Their physical prefixes are not implemented on this source baseline; none is invented here. Each new writer must add a concrete classified prefix or the guard fails. No identity-file prefix is approved (owner decision 13 A).

## Maintenance and recovery handoff

- `node scripts/build-r2-inventory.mjs` prints this inventory; `--write` regenerates it; `--check` validates classification/provenance and fails stale generated output. No flag approves a prefix automatically.
- Review changed stored-key provenance against its named writer before updating a review hash. Do not copy an error hash into the JSON without inspecting the source contract.
- #6428 consumes the version-1 `classes` list. Only explicit `locked_copy: yes`, `class: record`, recorded counsel basis and approved duration may qualify; this inventory currently enables none. Apply #6654 suppression decisions on restore.
- #6651 owns write-once behavior; this task changes no Worker call site. #6428 owns the existing contracts/KYC recovery rows and setup steps 4–5.
- Preview aliases share source classification only. They inherit no production retention promise or locked-copy approval.
